adaptations_before_results: Universe of the daily variants: point-in-time top 500 by turnover in BOTH eras (events_daily.py), not the lab's 97 current NIFTY-100 names / old-era top 100. Decided from counts of disclosure ROWS (promoter market purchases >= Rs 1 cr in the top 100: a few dozen a year) and because the published tests use NIFTY 500; no return was looked at.

Results timestamp: first version (announcement within 48 h / 24 h before the structured filing) put the reaction on the wrong day in 2013-2018 (UNSIGNED check: median |abnormal return| and volume on the assigned day were at the level of ordinary days; 4-20 % agreement with the board-meeting feed). Replaced by the rule in availability_rule.results; after it every era peaks on the assigned day (|AR| 2.7-2.9 % vs 1.4-1.5 %, volume 1.7-2.4 x) and 76-99 % of dates agree with the board-meeting feed. Only unsigned magnitudes and counts were used.
Results from 2025-04 come from NSE's 'Integrated Filing - Financials' feed (the older results feed stops there).

Earnings-gap variant: Chan's published rule (gap >= 0.5 x 90-day std of overnight returns, both directions, exit at the close) on minute bars, instead of the sketched 3 % gap + opening-range rule (too few events in 97 names for the 150-trade gate).
Insider disclosures exist on NSE from 2015-11-27 (SEBI PIT 2015): no insider test before that.
Stock futures do not fit a Rs 10 lakh account at 1 % risk (one lot risks far more): the account rows of the short variants will show skipped signals; stated here before the run.

availability_rule.board_meetings: a notice is usable if broadcast before 09:00 IST of the entry session; the session calendar (exchange holidays) is treated as public
availability_rule.insider: a disclosure is usable for an order only if its NSE broadcast time is before 09:00 IST of the entry session (transaction / intimation dates are never used for timing)
availability_rule.intraday: results first public at / after the previous session's 15:30 and before 09:00 today
availability_rule.results: first_ts = min(earliest structured results filing broadcast, earliest 'Financial Result Updates' announcement within 48 h before it, earliest 'Outcome of Board Meeting' announcement within 24 h before it); reaction session = the first session whose 15:30 close is after first_ts; entry at the following session's open

corporate_action_rule: a trade whose (decision day, exit day] contains an unexplained overnight gap (open / previous close < 0.6 or > 1.67) or a demerger / scheme / large-rights ex-day of its symbol is dropped and counted; reported both ways

sources: NSE corporate-announcements (Financial Result Updates, Outcome of Board Meeting)

2012-23.note: insider disclosures start 2015-11-27: insider variants' H1 = 2015-12..2017-12

2016-23.protocol: protocol_min_oos.judge on the intraday variant, dirty-link rule applied

2023-26.protocol: protocol.evaluate, DISCOVERY 70 % (H1 / H2) + FINAL 30 %, FINAL once and only for screen passers

eras.old_era_look: EVERY variant gets its old-era judgement, whatever its 2023-26 result

fills_costs.dividends: prices are NOT dividend-adjusted (understates longs, overstates shorts by the dividends paid during the hold)
fills_costs.shorts: stock future on the cash price, futures costs, no basis / lot / roll

min_oos.universe: today's NIFTY-100 names with Kite minute bars 2016-01-01..2023-11-09 (survivorship-biased); no point-in-time gate

oos.universe: universe_monthly.csv: top 100 by 60-session turnover before each month, gate on decision day

gates.proven: CONFIRMED on 2023-26 FINAL and OOS-CONFIRMED on the old era and DSR >= 0.95 with N = all 2023-26 trials in the ledger (the fair N = this study's variants is also reported)

name: events_v1
question: Do promoter / insider open-market purchases and earnings-announcement moves give a tradable edge on NSE stocks after costs, in two eras?

report_only.account: capital.py: Rs 10 lakh, 1 % risk per trade from the stop distance, config.py position limits, signals in time order; stock-future lot ~ Rs 7.5 lakh contract (approximate)
report_only.event_study: mean / median abnormal return vs NIFTY over each holding window, 2000 month-block bootstrap resamples, seed 20261114
report_only.placebo: every event moved to a random session of the same symbol and era (same count, time of day kept, seed 20261114), same pipeline
report_only.planted_edge: synthetic promoter purchases broadcast the evening before each symbol's best 2 % of 20-session forward returns must show a large profit; the same events delayed 25 sessions must not

trials: each of the 9 variants is one trial on 2023-26 and one on its old era; the 9 report-only twins are recorded as stage 'explore' (they count in N, they cannot be proven)

universe.daily_variants: point-in-time: each month's top 500 NSE equity shares by 60-session average turnover (computed from data before the month); a position may be opened only on a member day; short variants additionally need a stock future traded on the decision day
universe.intraday_variant: lab minute bars: 2023-26 = 97 of today's NIFTY-100 names, 2016-23 = today's NIFTY-100 names (both SURVIVORSHIP-BIASED)

variants.rule: Promoter market purchases >= Rs 1 cr disclosed within 30 days: buy next open, hold 20 sessions, 20 % stop
Promoter market purchases >= Rs 1 cr disclosed within 30 days: buy next open, hold 60 sessions, 20 % stop
Promoter market purchases >= Rs 1 cr within 30 days while >= 20 % below the 252-session high: hold 60
Promoter market sales >= Rs 1 cr disclosed within 30 days: short the stock future next open, 20 sessions
Results reaction day abnormal return >= +4 % vs NIFTY on above-average volume: buy next open, 20 sessions
Results reaction day abnormal return >= +4 % vs NIFTY on above-average volume: buy next open, 60 sessions
Results reaction day abnormal return <= -4 % vs NIFTY on above-average volume: short the future, 20 sessions
Buy 5 sessions before the notified results board meeting, sell at the close of the last session before it
Results out overnight and the opening gap >= 0.5 x 90-session overnight std: trade with the gap to 15:15
